items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: I knew them before I left Los Angeles... we say, 'Hey, Nancy, hey, Penny.'

ctx.x: Oh, had a fight on the bus. This'll kill you. We had just left the Orpheum Theatre here in Los Angeles. And it was two girls in the dressing room, and I knew them before I left Los Angeles. They used to hang out with the redhead kid, called Red. He later hung out with Lee Young. And we ran into them, Big Sid and I walked in, and we say, "Hey, Nancy, hey, Penny." Well, Nancy ended up marrying Lucky Millinder. Tall girl, red hair. And so, Sid and I ended up taking the two of them out to the dressing room. And…

So we had a trumpet player there named Frank Galbraith, called him Smoothie. He plays a beautiful trumpet. And he held it up until Louis was able to play. Wherever we went, they explained to them, you know, that Louis wasn't able to appear, but we think you're enjoy this young man's playing. Give him a hand. He'd come out with a handkerchief in his hand like Pops.
